capability.summary: Look up nutrition metadata for one named fruit
capability.description: Fetches Fruityvice's fixed fruit-by-name endpoint for one fruit and returns the provider's nutrition object in the shared JSON envelope. It is reference data lookup, not dietary advice or calorie calculation.
capability.problem_space: Named-fruit nutrition metadata retrieval; not medical nutrition counseling, meal planning, food-product barcode lookup, or nutrient recomputation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: fruit path value at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Fruityvice fruit nutrition object or provider error, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one fruit name path segment understood by Fruityvice
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no nutrient selection, serving-size conversion, fuzzy search, list endpoint, pagination, or batch input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not URL-encode, parse, paginate, or truncate the provider object
missing input is not validated and is interpolated into the path
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Fruityvice fruit nutrition metadata, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: retrieve Fruityvice metadata for a fruit
negative_intents: look up packaged products or calculate a custom serving

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Fruityvice fruit nutrition metadata, URL, and HTTP status.
